reviews.title: Solid PSU.
reviews.comment:
Easy to install and manage versus standard power supplies, the Corsair Shift series power supplies are a solid choice for any build in cases where you have a “basement” for the power supply or you have a dual-chamber case. This is for builds with cards up to the 4070TiSuper/5070Ti, 3080 series, 9070 non-XT, 7900GRE, 6950XT, or any ARC card.

Just keep in mind that this PSU has a 0db mode so turning it on doesn’t mean the fan spins up.

This fit well in a Lian Li SUP01 case. The build is a 7600X3D with a ARC B580, and it’s rock solid stable.
